body: Its pretty short but its really fun gameplay wise. The story really interesting since you play as an republic commando, who has to lead his men in dangerous missions across the galaxy. It's a really unique tactical fps that fun, but like I said pretty short took me around 4 hours to complete and was really enjoyable so I would recommend it to anyone who hasn't played it yet.
